title: Formal Sick Leave Email to Manager
instructions: Write a professional email to your manager informing them that you are unwell with fever and requesting 1 day of sick leave. Mention who will handle urgent queries in your absence.
sample_answer:
Dear Mr. Ramesh,

I am writing to inform you that I am unwell with fever today and will be unable to attend office. I request you to grant me one day of sick leave for August 23rd.

I have handed over my urgent client support tasks to Priya. I will check urgent emails periodically.

Thank you for your understanding.

Sincerely,
Karthik

title: Opinion: AI in English Learning
instructions: Express your opinion on how AI tools and conversational tutors help students learn English faster and overcome shyness.
sample_answer: In my view, AI-powered language tools provide a safe, non-judgmental environment for beginners to practice spoken English. Unlike traditional classrooms where students fear making grammar mistakes in front of peers, AI tutors give instant, constructive feedback with bilingual explanations. This boosts learner confidence and accelerates fluency dramatically.
